old:
/* [E20260825-XLSMASTER] Excel Form 행 원천 전환 (사용자 지시 2026-08-25).
       구: MAIN GRID 조회 파이프라인(GET 내부호출 -> GT_TEMP 재사용) — 수량 원장·버전·기간 종속.
       신: 판가 마스터 SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE(MEASURE='LOC') = LOC 대상 정본
           (일괄입력 팝업 SP 동일 원천) — 조회조건 division 기준 직생성. MAIN GET 미호출. */
    /* [E20260825-XLSBATCH] 추출 기준 = Price Batch Input(일괄입력) 팝업 SP 동일 (사용자 지시 2026-08-25).
       P_..._SAVE_PRICE_POPUP 81 분기 B2(GTT_PLAN_DATA) 술어 이식: 동적 구간 YYYYMMDD BETWEEN +
       SITE(SALES,VALID)/SITE_ITEM(VALID) 게이트. MEASURE='LOC' 는 원문 무필터와 키 등가 실측(2,468=2,468 —
       KRW/USD 는 환산 시리즈로 키 동일) — 1/3 비용의 등가 필터로 유지. 일괄입력 PRICE 축은 제외(양식은 W 슬롯 입력). */
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO n_key_cnt
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT F.PROJECT_CODE, F.SCM_SITE_ID, F.ITEM_ID, F.INCOTERMS
                          , F.FCST_TYPE, F.DOM_EXP, F.CURRENCY
              FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE F
             WHERE F.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id AND F.MEASURE = 'LOC'
               AND F.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN p_from_yyyymmdd AND p_to_yyyymmdd
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE B
                            WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = F.SCM_SITE_ID
                              AND B.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y')
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                            WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND B.PROJECT_CODE = F.PROJECT_CODE
                              AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = F.SCM_SITE_ID AND B.ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID
                              AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'));
new:
/* [E20260825-XLSPRICECOL] Excel Form 컬럼 = 단가 테이블(SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE) 컬럼 구성 (사용자 지시 2026-08-25).
       행 축 = 원장 키 그대로 (PLANT_SITE_ID 포함 — 구 접힘 폐지, 'Plant Site 축 미결' 해소).
       추출 기준 = 일괄입력 팝업 B2 동일(XLSBATCH 승계): 동적 구간 BETWEEN + SITE(SALES)/SITE_ITEM/ITEM_V 게이트.
       END_CUSTOMER 는 단가 테이블에 없는 컬럼 — 양식에서 제거 (업로드 토큰도 Project Code 로 교체, HEADER_CONTENT 동시 배포). */
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO n_key_cnt
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT F.PROJECT_CODE, F.SCM_SITE_ID, F.PLANT_SITE_ID, F.ITEM_ID
                          , F.INCOTERMS, F.FCST_TYPE, F.DOM_EXP, F.CURRENCY
              FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE F
             WHERE F.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id AND F.MEASURE = 'LOC'
               AND F.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN p_from_yyyymmdd AND p_to_yyyymmdd
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE B
                            WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = F.SCM_SITE_ID
                              AND B.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y')
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
                            WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID AND B.PROJECT_CODE = F.PROJECT_CODE
                              AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = F.SCM_SITE_ID AND B.ITEM_ID = F.ITEM_ID
                              AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'));

OPEN o_rc1 FOR
    WITH WT_RAW AS (
        /* [E20260825-XLSMASTER perf2] 1단 — 174K 원장을 키(2.4K)로 먼저 접는다.
           구 1단 구성(원장 174K x ITEM_V 뷰 LEFT JOIN 후 GROUP BY)은 550s+ 실측 —
           무거운 뷰 조인을 접기 전에 태운 것이 병목. 보강 조인은 2단(키 행수)에서만. */
        SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
               F.DIVISION_ID
             , F.PROJECT_CODE
             , F.SCM_SITE_ID
             , F.ITEM_ID
             , F.INCOTERMS
             , F.FCST_TYPE
             , F.DOM_EXP
             , F.CURRENCY
             , MAX(F.LAST_UPDATED_BY)                AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE F
         WHERE F.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
           AND F.MEASURE     = 'LOC'
           /* [E20260825-XLSBATCH] 일괄입력 B2 동일 — 동적 구간의 단가 대상만 (사용자 지시 2026-08-25) */
           AND F.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN p_from_yyyymmdd AND p_to_yyyymmdd
           /* [E20260825-XLSMASTER perf3] 선택 필터는 여기(174K 스캔)이 아니라 최종 WHERE(2.4K)에서 —
              NVL(:p,'ALL')='ALL' OR INSTR 바인드 관용구가 이 단계 플랜을 파괴(리터럴 3s vs 바인드 150s+ 실측). */
         GROUP BY F.DIVISION_ID, F.PROJECT_CODE, F.SCM_SITE_ID, F.ITEM_ID
                , F.INCOTERMS, F.FCST_TYPE, F.DOM_EXP, F.CURRENCY
    )
    , WT_ITEM AS (
        /* [E20260825-XLSBATCH2] ITEM_V 선실현 — INNER 전환 후 옵티마이저가 VIEW PUSHED PREDICATE
           + NL(추정 433만행)로 행별 평가(ASH 라인27 INDEX SKIP SCAN CPU 지배 실측, hook #129 계보).
           일괄입력 팝업 원문도 동일 사유로 GTT_DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V 선적재 — 등가 처방(division 1회 실현). */
        SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
               IV0.DIVISION_ID, IV0.ITEM_ID, IV0.ITEM_NAME, IV0.NICK_NAME, IV0.ITEM_TYPE
             , IV0.MDM_PROJECT_NAME, IV0.MIN_CAPACITY, IV0.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, IV0.CELL_TYPE
             , IV0.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL, IV0.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
             , IV0.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC, IV0.FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
          FROM SCM_MGR.DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V IV0
         WHERE IV0.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
    )
    , WT_KEY AS (
        /* [E20260825-XLSMASTER] 2단 — 키 행수에서만 마스터 보강 (SITE·SITE_ITEM = 유효성 게이트 겸용,
           일괄입력 팝업 SP 동일 술어. SITE_ITEM PK = div+project+site+item 1:1 / ITEM_V = div+item 1:1).
           END_CUSTOMER = PROJECT_CODE ([DIV81] 규약) / CELL_PROD_SITE_ID = '-' (마스터에 축 없음).
           dept·biztype·owner·sender 축은 마스터 매핑 부재 — 미적용 (MAIN 종속 폐지의 의도적 결과). */
        SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
               R.DIVISION_ID
             , R.PROJECT_CODE                        AS END_CUSTOMER
             /* [E20260825-XLSPRJ] 컬럼 위치 정정 (사용자 지시 2026-08-25): 프로젝트 코드를 제 컬럼
                (메타 colNm=PROJECT_CODE)으로도 출력 + 일괄입력 팝업 동일 NAME/OWNER 보강.
                END_CUSTOMER 별칭은 업로드 키 계약(파일 'End Customer' 토큰 = 81 키 유일 통로)이라 유지. */
             , R.PROJECT_CODE
             , PJ.PROJECT_NAME
             , PJ.PROJECT_OWNER
             , R.SCM_SITE_ID
             , R.ITEM_ID
             , R.INCOTERMS
             , R.FCST_TYPE
             , R.DOM_EXP
             , '-'                                   AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
             , R.CURRENCY
             , SI.DEPT_ID                            AS TEAM_ID
             , SD.DEPT_NAME_KO                       AS TEAM_NAME_KO
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS COUNTRY_NAME
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS CITY_NAME
             , IV.ITEM_NAME
             , IV.NICK_NAME
             , IV.ITEM_TYPE
             , SI.CUST_GROUP
             , SI.CUST_GROUP_DTL
             , SI.OWNER
             , SI.APPLICATION
             , SI.ROUTE
             , IV.MDM_PROJECT_NAME
             , IV.MIN_CAPACITY
             , IV.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
             , IV.CELL_TYPE
             , IV.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL           AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
             , IV.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS FORECAST_INFO_ALL
             , IV.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
             , IV.FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS CELL_MODEL_NICK_NAME
             , MS0.VMI_YN
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS DMS_SALES
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS DMS_CUSTOMER
             , ' '                                   AS AS_FROM_SITE
             , R.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))           AS SENDER_NAME
          FROM WT_RAW R
         INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE MS0
            ON  MS0.DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND MS0.SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND MS0.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'  --[E20260825-XLSBATCH] 일괄입력 최종 취합 INNER JOIN(SITE_TYPE='SALES') 동일
            AND MS0.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
            ON  SI.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND SI.PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE
            AND SI.SCM_SITE_ID  = R.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND SI.ITEM_ID      = R.ITEM_ID
            AND SI.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
         INNER JOIN WT_ITEM IV  --[E20260825-XLSBATCH] 일괄입력 최종 취합 INNER JOIN(ITEM) 동일 (선실현본)
            ON  IV.DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND IV.ITEM_ID     = R.ITEM_ID
          LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO SD
            ON  SD.DEPT_ID = SI.DEPT_ID
          LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_PROJECT PJ  --[E20260825-XLSPRJ] (DIV,CODE) 유일 실측 1,158=1,158 — 행 불증식
            ON  PJ.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND PJ.PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE
    )
    -- 입력 가능 measure (화면 개인화 무관 — INSERT_YN='Y')
    , WT_MEASURE AS (
        SELECT L.SEGMENT2  AS DIVISION_ID
             , L.SEGMENT3  AS MEASURE_CODE
             , L.SEGMENT4  AS MEASURE_NAME
             , L.ATTRIBUTE3 AS VMI_COND
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.SEGMENT2 ORDER BY L.SEGMENT3) AS MEASURE_SORT
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
         INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER M
            ON  M.LOOKUP_TYPE = L.LOOKUP_TYPE
            AND M.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_UI_EDITABLE_MEASURE'
           AND L.SEGMENT1    = 'DMF0082'
           AND L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND L.ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y'          -- INSERT_YN (검증 SP L4709 동일)
           AND L.SEGMENT3    = 'LOC'        /* [E20260819-XLS81LOC] 대상 measure LOC 한정 (2026-08-19 사용자 지시) */
    )
    -- End Customer 코드 → 명칭 (검증 SP L4387~4393 역방향)
    , WT_EC AS (
        SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DIVISION_ID, SEGMENT2 AS EC_CODE, MAX(SEGMENT3) AS EC_NAME
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' AND SEGMENT2 <> '-'
         GROUP BY SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2
    )
    -- FCST Type 코드 → 명칭 (검증 SP L4586~4591 역방향)
    , WT_FCST AS (
        SELECT SEGMENT1 AS FCST_CODE, MAX(SEGMENT2) AS FCST_NAME
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, '-') <> 'Y'
         GROUP BY SEGMENT1
    )
    -- Cell Prod Site 코드 → 명칭 (검증 SP L4663~4667 역방향)
    , WT_CPS AS (
        SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CPS_CODE, MAX(ATTRIBUTE1) AS CPS_NAME
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
         GROUP BY SEGMENT1
    )
    SELECT /*+ LEADING(K MSR) USE_HASH(LP) NO_MERGE(LP) */  --[E20260825-XLSMASTER perf4] 바인드 플랜 고정 — LP 1회 실체화+해시 (리터럴 3s vs 바인드 35s+ 실측)
           K.DIVISION_ID
         , NVL(EC.EC_NAME, K.END_CUSTOMER)      AS END_CUSTOMER
         , K.SCM_SITE_ID
         , K.ITEM_ID
         , K.INCOTERMS
         , NVL(FT.FCST_NAME, K.FCST_TYPE)       AS FCST_TYPE
         , K.DOM_EXP
         , NVL(CP.CPS_NAME, K.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID) AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
         , K.CURRENCY
         , MSR.MEASURE_NAME                      AS MEASURE
         --
         , K.PROJECT_CODE, K.PROJECT_NAME, K.PROJECT_OWNER  --[E20260825-XLSPRJ]
         , K.TEAM_ID, K.TEAM_NAME_KO, K.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER, K.COUNTRY_NAME, K.CITY_NAME
         , K.ITEM_NAME, K.NICK_NAME, K.ITEM_TYPE, K.CUST_GROUP, K.CUST_GROUP_DTL
         , K.OWNER, K.APPLICATION, K.ROUTE, K.MDM_PROJECT_NAME, K.MIN_CAPACITY
         , K.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, K.CELL_TYPE, K.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
         , K.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT, K.FORECAST_INFO_ALL, K.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
         , K.FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION, K.CELL_MODEL_NICK_NAME, K.VMI_YN
         , K.DMS_SALES, K.DMS_CUSTOMER, K.AS_FROM_SITE, K.LAST_UPDATED_BY, K.SENDER_NAME
         -- ⭐ 업로드 불가 예고 플래그 — 마스터 결핍으로 **검증 SP 역변환이 실패할 행**을 미리 표시한다.
         --    (사내 실측 2026-08-13 div40 3개월: EC 1종 'SUZUKI' / CellProdSite 2종 EG00-A·AZ00-A / Incoterms 1종)
         --    양식에 실어 보내고 업로드에서야 ERROR 로 알려주면 사용자가 원인을 못 찾는다.
         , RTRIM(
             '' ||  --[E20260825-XLSMASTER perf] EC warn 상관 서브쿼리 제거 — 마스터 기준은 EC=PROJECT_CODE∈SITE_ITEM 항상 참(WT_KEY INNER JOIN)
             CASE WHEN CP.CPS_NAME IS NULL THEN 'CELL_PROD_SITE,' ELSE '' END ||
             CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LI
                                    WHERE LI.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS' AND LI.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                      AND LI.SEGMENT2 = K.INCOTERMS)
                  THEN 'INCOTERMS,' ELSE '' END
           , ',') AS FORM_WARN
         /* [E20260820-XLSWEEKLY] 기간 축 = 동적 주차 (A안 사용자 확정 2026-08-20) — 조회기간과 당주-이후의 교집합 주 시작일
            (BASIS_START_DATE) 슬롯 W01~W26. 실제 주차 목록은 o_result_cursor.WEEK_LIST(CSV) 로 내려주고
            FE 가 W 슬롯을 날짜 헤더(YYYYMMDD 원형 — BE FileServiceImpl 1단 날짜헤더 인식 규격)로 치환한다.
            값 = 기존 LOC 원장 주차 대표값(XLSFORM2 승계 — 주차 단위 재배선). */
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W01) END AS W01
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W02) END AS W02
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W03) END AS W03
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W04) END AS W04
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W05) END AS W05
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W06) END AS W06
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W07) END AS W07
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W08) END AS W08
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W09) END AS W09
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W10) END AS W10
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W11) END AS W11
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W12) END AS W12
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W13) END AS W13
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W14) END AS W14
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W15) END AS W15
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W16) END AS W16
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W17) END AS W17
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W18) END AS W18
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W19) END AS W19
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W20) END AS W20
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W21) END AS W21
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W22) END AS W22
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W23) END AS W23
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W24) END AS W24
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W25) END AS W25
         , CASE WHEN MSR.MEASURE_CODE = 'LOC' THEN TO_CHAR(LP.W26) END AS W26
      FROM WT_KEY K
     INNER JOIN WT_MEASURE MSR
        ON MSR.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE MS
        ON  MS.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID
        AND MS.SCM_SITE_ID = K.SCM_SITE_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN WT_EC EC
        ON  EC.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID
        AND EC.EC_CODE     = K.END_CUSTOMER
      LEFT OUTER JOIN WT_FCST FT
        ON  FT.FCST_CODE   = K.FCST_TYPE
      LEFT OUTER JOIN WT_CPS CP
        ON  CP.CPS_CODE    = K.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
      /* [E20260820-XLSWEEKLY] 기존 LOC 원장 주차별 대표값 (주 시작일 = 캘린더 BASIS_START_DATE, MAX 집계) */
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT B.PROJECT_CODE, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.INCOTERMS, B.DOM_EXP, B.FCST_TYPE, B.CURRENCY
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 1 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W01
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 2 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W02
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 3 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W03
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 4 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W04
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 5 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W05
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 6 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W06
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 7 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W07
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 8 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W08
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 9 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W09
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 10 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W10
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 11 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W11
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 12 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W12
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 13 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W13
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 14 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W14
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 15 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W15
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 16 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W16
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 17 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W17
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 18 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W18
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 19 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W19
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 20 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W20
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 21 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W21
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 22 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W22
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 23 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W23
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 24 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W24
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 25 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W25
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 26 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W26
          FROM  (SELECT P.PROJECT_CODE, P.SCM_SITE_ID, P.ITEM_ID, P.INCOTERMS, P.DOM_EXP, P.FCST_TYPE, P.CURRENCY
                      , C.BASIS_START_DATE AS WK, MAX(P.PRICE) AS PRICE
                 FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE P
                 JOIN   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C ON C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P.YYYYMMDD
                 WHERE  P.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
                 AND    P.MEASURE = 'LOC'
                 AND    P.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN GREATEST(p_from_yyyymmdd, TO_CHAR(SCM_MGR.FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND p_to_yyyymmdd
                 GROUP BY P.PROJECT_CODE, P.SCM_SITE_ID, P.ITEM_ID, P.INCOTERMS, P.DOM_EXP, P.FCST_TYPE, P.CURRENCY
                        , C.BASIS_START_DATE) B
          JOIN  (SELECT WK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WK) AS RN
                 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT C.BASIS_START_DATE AS WK
                         FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                        WHERE C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN GREATEST(p_from_yyyymmdd, TO_CHAR(SCM_MGR.FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND p_to_yyyymmdd
                          AND C.BASIS_START_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SCM_MGR.FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD'))) W
            ON  W.WK = B.WK AND W.RN <= 26
          GROUP BY B.PROJECT_CODE, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.INCOTERMS, B.DOM_EXP, B.FCST_TYPE, B.CURRENCY
      ) LP
        ON  LP.PROJECT_CODE = K.END_CUSTOMER
        AND LP.SCM_SITE_ID  = K.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND LP.ITEM_ID      = K.ITEM_ID
        AND LP.INCOTERMS    = K.INCOTERMS
        AND LP.DOM_EXP      = K.DOM_EXP
        AND LP.FCST_TYPE    = K.FCST_TYPE
        AND LP.CURRENCY     = K.CURRENCY
     -- VMI 조건 = 검증 SP L4711~4716 동일 술어 (양식에 넣어놓고 업로드에서 거부되는 일이 없도록)
     WHERE ( ( NVL(MS.VMI_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND MSR.VMI_COND <> 'Y' )
             OR NVL(MS.VMI_YN, 'N') = 'Y' )
       --[E20260825-XLSMASTER perf3] 선택 필터 (키 2.4K 행 단계 — 바인드여도 무해)
       AND (NVL(p_sales_site,   'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_sales_site   || ',', ',' || K.SCM_SITE_ID  || ',') > 0)
       AND (NVL(p_item_id,      'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_item_id      || ',', ',' || K.ITEM_ID      || ',') > 0)
       AND (NVL(p_end_customer, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_end_customer || ',', ',' || K.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0)
       AND (NVL(p_project_code, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_project_code || ',', ',' || K.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0)
     ORDER BY K.END_CUSTOMER, K.SCM_SITE_ID, K.ITEM_ID, K.FCST_TYPE
            , K.INCOTERMS, K.DOM_EXP, K.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID, MSR.MEASURE_SORT;
new:
OPEN o_rc1 FOR
    WITH WT_RAW AS (
        /* [E20260825-XLSPRICECOL] 1단 — 원장을 원장 키 그대로(PLANT 포함) 접는다. 주차 값은 LP 에서. */
        SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
               F.DIVISION_ID
             , F.PROJECT_CODE
             , F.SCM_SITE_ID
             , F.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , F.ITEM_ID
             , F.INCOTERMS
             , F.FCST_TYPE
             , F.DOM_EXP
             , F.CURRENCY
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE F
         WHERE F.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
           AND F.MEASURE     = 'LOC'
           AND F.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN p_from_yyyymmdd AND p_to_yyyymmdd   --[E20260825-XLSBATCH] 동적 구간
           /* [E20260825-XLSMASTER perf3] 선택 필터는 최종 WHERE(키 단계)에서 — 바인드 OR 관용구 플랜 파괴 방지 */
         GROUP BY F.DIVISION_ID, F.PROJECT_CODE, F.SCM_SITE_ID, F.PLANT_SITE_ID, F.ITEM_ID
                , F.INCOTERMS, F.FCST_TYPE, F.DOM_EXP, F.CURRENCY
    )
    , WT_ITEM AS (
        /* [E20260825-XLSBATCH2] ITEM_V 선실현 — PUSHED PREDICATE 행별 폭발 방지 (게이트 전용) */
        SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */ IV0.DIVISION_ID, IV0.ITEM_ID
          FROM SCM_MGR.DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V IV0
         WHERE IV0.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
    )
    , WT_KEY AS (
        /* [E20260825-XLSPRICECOL] 2단 — 게이트(일괄입력 동일: SITE SALES/SITE_ITEM/ITEM_V) + 프로젝트 명/오너 보강.
           출력 = 단가 테이블 컬럼 축 + PROJECT_NAME/OWNER(정보성). SITE_END_CUSTOMER 는 조회조건 EC 필터 전용
           (일괄입력 최종 취합의 81 EC 필터 = C.END_CUSTOMER 동일 축 — 화면 표시는 안 한다). */
        SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
               R.DIVISION_ID
             , R.PROJECT_CODE
             , R.SCM_SITE_ID
             , R.PLANT_SITE_ID
             , R.ITEM_ID
             , R.INCOTERMS
             , R.FCST_TYPE
             , R.DOM_EXP
             , R.CURRENCY
             , PJ.PROJECT_NAME
             , PJ.PROJECT_OWNER
             , MS0.END_CUSTOMER                      AS SITE_END_CUSTOMER
          FROM WT_RAW R
         INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE MS0
            ON  MS0.DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND MS0.SCM_SITE_ID = R.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND MS0.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
            AND MS0.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI
            ON  SI.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND SI.PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE
            AND SI.SCM_SITE_ID  = R.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND SI.ITEM_ID      = R.ITEM_ID
            AND SI.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
         INNER JOIN WT_ITEM IV
            ON  IV.DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND IV.ITEM_ID     = R.ITEM_ID
          LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_PROJECT PJ  --[E20260825-XLSPRJ] (DIV,CODE) 유일 실측 — 행 불증식
            ON  PJ.DIVISION_ID  = R.DIVISION_ID
            AND PJ.PROJECT_CODE = R.PROJECT_CODE
    )
    -- 입력 가능 measure (화면 개인화 무관 — INSERT_YN='Y')
    , WT_MEASURE AS (
        SELECT L.SEGMENT2  AS DIVISION_ID
             , L.SEGMENT3  AS MEASURE_CODE
             , L.SEGMENT4  AS MEASURE_NAME
             , L.ATTRIBUTE3 AS VMI_COND
             , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY L.SEGMENT2 ORDER BY L.SEGMENT3) AS MEASURE_SORT
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
         INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER M
            ON  M.LOOKUP_TYPE = L.LOOKUP_TYPE
            AND M.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
         WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_UI_EDITABLE_MEASURE'
           AND L.SEGMENT1    = 'DMF0082'
           AND L.SEGMENT2    = p_division_id
           AND L.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND L.ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y'          -- INSERT_YN (검증 SP 동일)
           AND L.SEGMENT3    = 'LOC'        /* [E20260819-XLS81LOC] 대상 measure LOC 한정 */
    )
    -- FCST Type 코드 -> 명칭 (검증 SP 역방향 — 업로드가 명칭 기대)
    , WT_FCST AS (
        SELECT SEGMENT1 AS FCST_CODE, MAX(SEGMENT2) AS FCST_NAME
          FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, '-') <> 'Y'
         GROUP BY SEGMENT1
    )
    SELECT /*+ LEADING(K MSR) USE_HASH(LP) NO_MERGE(LP) */  --[E20260825-XLSMASTER perf4] 바인드 플랜 고정
           K.DIVISION_ID
         , K.PROJECT_CODE
         , K.SCM_SITE_ID
         , K.PLANT_SITE_ID
         , K.ITEM_ID
         , K.CURRENCY
         , MSR.MEASURE_NAME                      AS MEASURE
         , K.DOM_EXP
         , NVL(FT.FCST_NAME, K.FCST_TYPE)       AS FCST_TYPE
         , K.INCOTERMS
         , K.PROJECT_NAME
         , K.PROJECT_OWNER
         /* 업로드 불가 예고 — 검증 SP 역변환 실패 축 (FCST 명칭 미해소 / INCOTERMS lookup 부재) */
         , RTRIM(
             CASE WHEN FT.FCST_NAME IS NULL THEN 'FCST_TYPE,' ELSE '' END ||
             CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LI
                                    WHERE LI.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS' AND LI.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                      AND LI.SEGMENT2 = K.INCOTERMS)
                  THEN 'INCOTERMS,' ELSE '' END
           , ',') AS FORM_WARN
         /* [E20260820-XLSWEEKLY] 동적 주차 W 슬롯 — 값 = 해당 원장 행(키 완전 일치·PLANT 포함)의 주차 대표값 */
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W01) AS W01
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W02) AS W02
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W03) AS W03
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W04) AS W04
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W05) AS W05
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W06) AS W06
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W07) AS W07
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W08) AS W08
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W09) AS W09
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W10) AS W10
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W11) AS W11
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W12) AS W12
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W13) AS W13
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W14) AS W14
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W15) AS W15
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W16) AS W16
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W17) AS W17
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W18) AS W18
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W19) AS W19
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W20) AS W20
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W21) AS W21
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W22) AS W22
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W23) AS W23
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W24) AS W24
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W25) AS W25
         , TO_CHAR(LP.W26) AS W26
      FROM WT_KEY K
     INNER JOIN WT_MEASURE MSR
        ON MSR.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE MS
        ON  MS.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID
        AND MS.SCM_SITE_ID = K.SCM_SITE_ID
      LEFT OUTER JOIN WT_FCST FT
        ON  FT.FCST_CODE   = K.FCST_TYPE
      /* 기존 LOC 원장 주차별 대표값 — 키 완전 일치(PLANT 포함) 프리필 */
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (
          SELECT B.PROJECT_CODE, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.PLANT_SITE_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.INCOTERMS, B.DOM_EXP, B.FCST_TYPE, B.CURRENCY
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 1 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W01
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 2 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W02
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 3 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W03
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 4 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W04
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 5 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W05
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 6 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W06
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 7 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W07
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 8 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W08
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 9 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W09
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 10 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W10
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 11 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W11
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 12 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W12
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 13 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W13
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 14 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W14
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 15 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W15
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 16 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W16
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 17 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W17
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 18 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W18
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 19 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W19
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 20 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W20
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 21 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W21
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 22 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W22
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 23 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W23
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 24 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W24
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 25 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W25
               , MAX(CASE W.RN WHEN 26 THEN B.PRICE END) AS W26
          FROM  (SELECT P.PROJECT_CODE, P.SCM_SITE_ID, P.PLANT_SITE_ID, P.ITEM_ID, P.INCOTERMS, P.DOM_EXP, P.FCST_TYPE, P.CURRENCY
                      , C.BASIS_START_DATE AS WK, MAX(P.PRICE) AS PRICE
                 FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_FUTURE_PRICE P
                 JOIN   SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C ON C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P.YYYYMMDD
                 WHERE  P.DIVISION_ID = p_division_id
                 AND    P.MEASURE = 'LOC'
                 AND    P.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN GREATEST(p_from_yyyymmdd, TO_CHAR(SCM_MGR.FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND p_to_yyyymmdd
                 GROUP BY P.PROJECT_CODE, P.SCM_SITE_ID, P.PLANT_SITE_ID, P.ITEM_ID, P.INCOTERMS, P.DOM_EXP, P.FCST_TYPE, P.CURRENCY
                        , C.BASIS_START_DATE) B
          JOIN  (SELECT WK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WK) AS RN
                 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT C.BASIS_START_DATE AS WK
                         FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M C
                        WHERE C.BASIS_YYYYMMDD BETWEEN GREATEST(p_from_yyyymmdd, TO_CHAR(SCM_MGR.FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) AND p_to_yyyymmdd
                          AND C.BASIS_START_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SCM_MGR.FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD'))) W
            ON  W.WK = B.WK AND W.RN <= 26
          GROUP BY B.PROJECT_CODE, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.PLANT_SITE_ID, B.ITEM_ID, B.INCOTERMS, B.DOM_EXP, B.FCST_TYPE, B.CURRENCY
      ) LP
        ON  LP.PROJECT_CODE  = K.PROJECT_CODE
        AND LP.SCM_SITE_ID   = K.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND LP.PLANT_SITE_ID = K.PLANT_SITE_ID
        AND LP.ITEM_ID       = K.ITEM_ID
        AND LP.INCOTERMS     = K.INCOTERMS
        AND LP.DOM_EXP       = K.DOM_EXP
        AND LP.FCST_TYPE     = K.FCST_TYPE
        AND LP.CURRENCY      = K.CURRENCY
     -- VMI 조건 = 검증 SP 동일 술어
     WHERE ( ( NVL(MS.VMI_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND MSR.VMI_COND <> 'Y' )
             OR NVL(MS.VMI_YN, 'N') = 'Y' )
       --[E20260825-XLSMASTER perf3] 선택 필터 (키 단계 — 바인드여도 무해).
       -- EC 필터 축 = 사이트 파생 고객명 (일괄입력 최종 취합의 81 EC 필터 = C.END_CUSTOMER 동일)
       AND (NVL(p_sales_site,   'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_sales_site   || ',', ',' || K.SCM_SITE_ID  || ',') > 0)
       AND (NVL(p_item_id,      'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_item_id      || ',', ',' || K.ITEM_ID      || ',') > 0)
       AND (NVL(p_end_customer, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_end_customer || ',', ',' || K.SITE_END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0)
       AND (NVL(p_plant_site_id,'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_plant_site_id|| ',', ',' || K.PLANT_SITE_ID || ',') > 0)
       AND (NVL(p_project_code, 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || p_project_code || ',', ',' || K.PROJECT_CODE || ',') > 0)
     ORDER BY K.PROJECT_CODE, K.SCM_SITE_ID, K.PLANT_SITE_ID, K.ITEM_ID, K.FCST_TYPE
            , K.INCOTERMS, K.DOM_EXP, K.CURRENCY, MSR.MEASURE_SORT;
